title: Pure Crystal Beast
summary: Classic Crystal Beast and Ultimate Crystal build with Rainbow Bridge, generic staples, and an automatic Extra Deck. Whenever a Crystal Beast is destroyed in a Monster Zone, it places itself face-up in the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, fueling Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins, Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle, and the seven-name Ultimate Crystal bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus places any Crystal Beast monster from your hand, Deck, or GY face-up in your Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell whenever it is Normal, Flip, or Special Summoned.
Crystal Bond adds 1 Crystal Beast monster from the Deck to your hand and places a differently named Crystal Beast from the Deck directly into your Spell and Trap Zone.

Rainbow Bridge searches any Crystal Spell or Trap without a once-per-turn restriction, and Crystal Master Tributes itself from the field to search an Ultimate Crystal monster, Crystal Beast, or Crystal Spell/Trap.

summary.title: Opening: Crystal Bond + Sapphire Pegasus
steps: Activate Crystal Bond to add Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus to your hand and place Crystal Beast Rainbow Dragon in your Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Banish Crystal Beast Rainbow Dragon from your Spell and Trap Zone to Special Summon Crystal Beast Ruby Carbuncle from the Deck (with its effects negated) and search Rainbow Dragon.
Normal Summon Sapphire Pegasus to place another Crystal Beast in your Spell and Trap Zone, setting up Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins, Crystal Conclave, or Rank 4 and Link plays.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Rainbow Dragon Special Summons itself when 7 Crystal Beast cards with different names are on your field and/or in your GY, and can send all face-up Crystal Beasts you control to gain 1000 ATK each or banish all Crystal Beasts from the GY to shuffle every card on the field into the Deck.

Rainbow Overdragon Tributes itself as a Quick Effect to shuffle all cards on the field into the Deck, and Ultimate Crystal Magic sends 7 Crystal Beasts from your hand, field, or Deck to the GY when a Crystal Beast is destroyed by battle to Fusion Summon it.

Ultimate Crystal Rainbow Dragon Overdrive Contact Fuses by banishing 1 Ultimate Crystal monster and 7 Crystal Beasts, then Tributes itself as a Quick Effect to shuffle the entire field into the Deck and Special Summon any number of banished Crystal Beasts.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Ancient City - Rainbow Ruins gains cumulative effects for 1 to 5 Crystal Beasts in your Spell and Trap Zone: destruction immunity, halved battle damage, Spell/Trap negation, drawing 1 card, and Special Summoning a Crystal Beast from the Spell and Trap Zone.

Crystal Promise Special Summons a Crystal Beast from your Spell and Trap Zone (triggering Ruby Carbuncle to summon all the others), while Rainbow Refraction Special Summons Crystal Beasts from the Deck after Rainbow Dragon activates.
Crystal Conclave Special Summons a Crystal Beast from the Deck when one is destroyed and sends itself to bounce a Crystal card and any card on the field.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The seven Advanced Crystal Beast monsters require Advanced Dark in a Field Zone to stay on the field and belong in a separate Advanced Dark build.
